events.title: 周回強化の初期化、コントローラ操作、チュートリアルを実装
events.summary: Thank you for playing Monmusu Rush. The game has been updated to version 1.0.6. This update centers on three additions: resetting run-to-run upgrades, controller support, and a tutorial. "Reset to Default" buttons for run-to-run upgrades Reset your Shop purchases A "Reset to Default" button has been added to the Shop. Everything you have bought is returned to its unpurchased state at once. All Prism Gummies you spent are refunded in full, so you can freely try rebuilding your setup from scratch.

Fixed a bug where Redraw could not be selected when the deck went from 0 cards to having cards again through a Retreat. events.summary: Update ver1.0.4 Now Available Thank you for playing the Monmusu Rush Demo.
